title: Oozy Spicy Moroccan Lamb Mechoui
description: A spicy and gooey Moroccan dish featuring lamb, jalapeno, and traditional mechoui flavors, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is gluten-free friendly and cooked in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in the earthenware bowl over medium heat on the stovetop.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Add the sliced jalapeno peppers, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the bowl.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the bowl with a lid or foil and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falling apart.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
